title: Functions
info: A function is a named set of steps you can use again.
Like a recipe name: say the name, and the steps run.
Using a function keeps code shorter and easier to fix.

questions.q: Why name a set of steps?
options: So they run only once ever

questions.q: A function is a bit like
options: a recipe you can follow by name

questions.q: What do we call a named group of steps?
If drawSquare is a function, using it twice
options: draws the square steps two times
turns the square into a circle automatically
